title: Nice storage keeps everything organized.
text: Nice storage keeps everything organized.. Is there a really good job of keeping all of the small snacks in my pantry organized. I don't have to have a bunch of plastic bags and boxes cluttering everything. Plus, I can see everything inside, what it is and if I need to replenish.

product_metadata.title: KEOUKE Airtight Food Storage Containers Set-11 PC Kitchen & Pantry Organization Containers BPA Free Plastic Cereal Containers with Labels
features: 🍬 Organize Your Kitchen and Pantry: You don’t have to worry about messy kitchens and refrigerators anymore. The airtight storage container helps you to keep the food in the kitchen in an orderly manner. Perfect for storing flour, sugar, rice, grain, nuts, beans, snacks, pasta, coffee and tea. The fresh-keeping bag can seal fruits, vegetables, and meat in the refrigerator to keep the food fresh all the time.

🍩 Multi-specification storage: The item contains 7 storage containers and 4 storage bags. It also comes with a label paper and a white marker. Includes 1 large container (8.0 cups /1.9L), 2 medium containers (5.1 cups /1.2L), 2 small containers (3.4 cups /0.8L), 2 mini containers (2.1 cups /0.5L), 1 Large storage bag(10* 7.9inch), 1 medium storage bag(8.5*7.3inch), 1 small storage bag(9*6.7inch) and 1 mini storage bag(10*7.9inch). Different sizes meet different storage needs.

🍪 Keep food dry and fresh: The cereal container is made of ABS, strong and durable. The lid adopts lid-lock mechanism, and the lid can be opened or closed with one hand. The silicone ring on the lid has good sealing properties, it can effectively isolate the air to ensure long-term preservation of food.

🥮 Easily stackable and clean: Although the food storage containers have different sizes, they can be stacked well, making full use of your storage space. Its size is also measured and designed, and it can fit snugly on the shelf on the side of the refrigerator.So you can use these storage containers in multiple scenarios。It should be noted that the containers are not dishwasher safe, and high temperatures can deform and brittle the plastic. Just put it under the faucet and rinse.
